info.name: Sahla API
info.description:
Requests for the Sahla Spring Boot backend. Covers Authentication, Farmers, Products, Grades, Pricing (Sprint 2), and Deliveries, Weight Capture, Manual Grading & Confirmation, Inventory Movements, Inventory Balance & History, and Delivery Audit Log (Sprint 3).

Known gap #1 (Farmers/Products): /api/auth/register always creates a WAREHOUSE_EMPLOYEE account and there is currently no API to assign ADMIN/MANAGER/RECEIVING_EMPLOYEE roles. Farmer endpoints require ADMIN, MANAGER, or RECEIVING_EMPLOYEE; Product create/update require ADMIN or MANAGER. Until role assignment exists, requests marked '(blocked by role gap)' below are correctly built against the API contract but will return 403 Forbidden when run with a self-registered account.

Known gap #2 (Grades/Pricing): this code lives on PR #7 / branch amansayrawan-patch-1, which does not compile as pushed - GradeDefinitionUpdateRequest, and the exception classes DuplicateResourceException/InvalidPricingException/ResourceNotFoundException under com.farmmanagement.backend.exception, are referenced but don't exist in the branch. Requests marked '(branch does not compile)' are built from the controller/service source as the intended contract and will start working once those classes are added and exception handling is wired up. That branch also never restricted Grades/Pricing endpoints by role, unlike Farmers/Products.

DT-50 through DT-53 (Deliveries, Weight Capture, Manual Grading & Confirmation) landed on origin/feature/delivery-management, and those three folders are now written against the real controller/service/DTO source, not a guess: no ApiResponse envelope (bodies are the raw DTO/Page; errors are a flat {timestamp, status, error, message, path}), ids are numeric (Long), delivery creation returns 200 (not 201), weight capture is POST and 409s if the delivery isn't PENDING, and grading (POST .../grade, ADMIN/MANAGER/INSPECTOR only) both grades and confirms in one call - there is no separate confirm/cancel endpoint. Exercising the happy path needs seed data for a farmer, a product, a GradeDefinition, and an active PriceRule (see the Grades/Pricing folders).

Known gap #3 (Inventory, DT-54 through DT-57): none of this backend exists on this branch yet - no controllers, DTOs, or DB migrations. The Inventory Movements, Inventory Balance & History, and Delivery Audit Log folders are written against a *proposed* contract inferred from the ticket titles and the Farmer -> Delivery -> Weight -> Grading -> Pricing -> Inventory -> Payment workflow in docs/README.md, not from real source. Every request in those folders is tagged '(planned, not implemented)' and will fail (connection refused or 404) until DT-54 through DT-57 land - revisit paths, field names, and status codes against the real implementation at that point.

Requests that only need GET on Products, or that expect 401/403, are runnable today.

Import the sibling environment file and select it before running requests. Run the Authentication folder first so {{authToken}} is populated.

item.name: Grades
item.description: Backend from PR #7 (branch amansayrawan-patch-1, GradeDefinitionController). NOT RUNNABLE YET: the branch does not compile. GradeDefinitionController and GradeDefinitionService both import com.farmmanagement.backend.dto.GradeDefinitionUpdateRequest, but that class does not exist anywhere in the branch. GradeDefinitionService also imports com.farmmanagement.backend.exception.DuplicateResourceException and com.farmmanagement.backend.exception.ResourceNotFoundException, neither of which exist either (there's a different ResourceNotFoundException under common.exception used by the Auth/Farmer/Product code, but that's a different class in a different package). The requests below are built from the controller/service source as the intended contract; the PUT body for updateGrade is inferred from GradeDefinitionService.updateGrade (name, description, displayOrder, active) since the real DTO is missing. Also note: this branch never touched SecurityConfig, so once it compiles, these endpoints only require .anyRequest().authenticated() - any logged-in role can call them, including create/update. That's inconsistent with how Farmers/Products lock create/update to ADMIN/MANAGER and worth a call with the leader.

item.name: Deliveries
item.description: Sprint 3 (DT-50/DT-51), confirmed against origin/feature/delivery-management (com.farmmanagement.backend.deliveries.DeliveryController). No ApiResponse envelope here - success bodies are the raw DTO/Page, and errors are a flat {timestamp, status, error, message, path} (see GlobalExceptionHandler). Ids are numeric (Long), not UUIDs. POST returns 200 OK (not 201). There is no confirm/cancel/delete endpoint - PUT only updates quantity/deliveryDate/notes, never status. The DeliveryStatus enum also has DELIVERED and CANCELLED values, but nothing in this branch transitions a delivery into either of them yet.

item.name: Weight Capture
item.description: Sprint 3 (DT-52), confirmed against origin/feature/delivery-management (DeliveryWeightController/DeliveryWeightService). POST, not PATCH, and returns 201 Created. Two business rules worth knowing: (1) the delivery must currently be PENDING or this 409s; (2) grossWeight - tareWeight must exactly equal the delivery's quantity field set at creation, or this 400s - it is not just 'must be positive'. Run 'Create Delivery - Valid' first so {{deliveryId}} and its quantity (380.0) are fresh.

request.description: 500.0 - 120.0 = 380.0, matching the quantity from Create Delivery. netWeight is computed server-side, not trusted from the client. On success the delivery moves PENDING -> WEIGHED. Requires ADMIN, MANAGER, or RECEIVING_EMPLOYEE.

exec: pm.test('Net weight matches the delivery quantity', function () {

item.name: Capture Weight - Tare Not Less Than Gross (400)

request.description: Run against a fresh, still-PENDING delivery. tareWeight >= grossWeight fails the first check in captureWeight ('Gross weight must be greater than tare weight') before the quantity-match check ever runs.

item.name: Capture Weight - Net Weight Does Not Match Quantity (400)

request.description: Run against a fresh, still-PENDING delivery created with quantity 380.0. 500.0 - 50.0 = 450.0 != 380.0, so this 400s even though tareWeight < grossWeight.
Run this immediately after 'Capture Weight - Valid' against the same {{deliveryId}}, which is now WEIGHED. captureWeight requires status PENDING and throws ConflictException otherwise.
A numeric id that should not exist.
No Authorization header.

item.name: Manual Grading & Confirmation
item.description: Sprint 3 (DT-53), confirmed against origin/feature/delivery-management (DeliveryGradeController/DeliveryGradeService). There is no separate confirm endpoint - POST .../grade both grades and confirms in one step: the delivery must be WEIGHED, the Grade enum value (GRADE_A/GRADE_B/GRADE_C/PREMIUM/REJECT) must map to a GradeDefinition for the delivery's product, and unless the grade is REJECT there must be exactly one active PriceRule to price it. Only ADMIN, MANAGER, or INSPECTOR may call this - notably not RECEIVING_EMPLOYEE, unlike Create/Weight. Run against a {{deliveryId}} that has already been through 'Capture Weight - Valid'.

item.name: Grade Delivery - Valid, Confirms with Price (201)

request.description: Requires a GradeDefinition with code GRADE_A configured for the delivery's product, and one active PriceRule for that product+grade (see the Grades/Pricing folders' seed data). On success the delivery status becomes CONFIRMED and totalPrice = priceRule.amount * delivery.quantity.

exec: pm.test('Resulting status is CONFIRMED with a computed price', function () {

request.description: Run against a different, already-WEIGHED delivery. REJECT skips the price-rule lookup entirely - resultingStatus is REJECTED and totalPrice stays null.

exec: pm.test('Resulting status is REJECTED with no price', function () {
